title: Finite locally free descent admits invariant affine neighbourhoods
statement: Let $p:X\to Y$ be finite, flat, locally of finite presentation and surjective [def-pc-finite-locally-free], and let $V\to X$ have a transport descent datum $D$ [def-pd-descent-datum]. Suppose every finite subset of $V$ lies in an affine open. Every point $v$ lies in an affine open $U\subseteq V$ contained in the inverse image of an affine open $B\subseteq Y$, and $U$ is transport-invariant: for every $T$, $f_1,f_2:T\to X$ with equal composites to $Y$, and $a:T\to V$ over $f_1$, if the image of $a$ lies in $U$, then the image of its transport to $f_2$ lies in $U$.

source.place: Groupoid Schemes, Tags 0H8K and 03JE; Algebra, Tag 00DS

proof.text: Form R=V times_Y X, source s=fst, second map q=snd, and target t=the universal transport. The source is finite by base change, so S=t(s^{-1}({v})) is finite. The identity section (id,V to X), naturality and transport_self show v belongs to S. Apply descent_orbit_saturated to obtain s^{-1}(S)=t^{-1}(S).

Choose an affine open B of Y containing the image of v. Over.w for the universal transported point implies t and s have equal composites to Y, so S lies over B. By hV choose an affine open A containing S; apply IsAffineOpen.exists_basicOpen_le_of_finite to the open A intersect inverse image of B, obtaining a principal affine open A0 containing S and lying over B.

Apply exists_descent_norm_affine_shrinking to S and A0, obtaining U affine, containing S, contained in A0, and with s^{-1}(U)=t^{-1}(U). This gives the required point membership and affine-base containment.

Given T,f1,f2,h,a, the pair (a.left,f2) lifts to g:T to R. Naturality of transport identifies g composed with t with the transported point, while g composed with s is a.left. For each point z of T, the source g(z) lies in U by the range hypothesis, and equality of the two inverse images puts its target in U. This proves the range inclusion for every T.

lean.statement: theorem exists_invariant_affine_neighbourhood {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {p : X ⟶ Y} [IsFinite p] [Flat p] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation p] [Surjective p] {V : Over X} (hV : ∀ s : Set V.left, s.Finite → ∃ U : V.left.Opens, IsAffineOpen U ∧ s ⊆ U) (D : Over.DescentDatum p V) (v : V.left) : ∃ U : V.left.Opens, v ∈ U ∧ IsAffineOpen U ∧ (∃ B : Y.Opens, IsAffineOpen B ∧ U ≤ (V.hom ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ B) ∧ ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (f₁ f₂ : T ⟶ X) (h : f₁ ≫ p = f₂ ≫ p) (a : Over.mk f₁ ⟶ V), Set.range a.left ⊆ U → Set.range (D.transport f₁ f₂ h a).left ⊆ U
